integrity: Analytic proofs supplemented by separately implemented finite-dimensional numerical diagnostics, which are not an infinite-size certificate. No independent audit or external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: All results concern finite connected simple graphs, ordinary unweighted combinatorial graph Laplacians and independently refreshed edge sets of strictly interior probabilities. A universal formula is proved only for step durations outside integer multiples of pi, with an explicit P3 boundary example. Limit is in the ensemble-averaged channel, not individual trajectories. Equal-weight, fixed-step, and finite-size restrictions are essential; historical priority and general graph-resonance classification remain unproved.
title: Universal finite-step mixing and stroboscopic memory in dynamically percolated quantum graphs
